generalNotes.subject: Mirror filenames and actual client versions
notes: The 3.73 single-file Installer is also mirrored as DarkAges-3.61.exe, DarkAges_Key_3.71.exe and DarkAges_Key_5.21.exe. Those copies are byte-identical; their names do not establish changed 3.61, 3.71 or 5.21 clients
The recovered genuine 5.21 ZIP contains its own three-part Wise Installer and differs from the mislabeled 5.21 mirror of 3.73

DarkAges-4.52.zip contains the complete original 4.51 multipart Installer. Each ZIP member matches the corresponding official /451/multiple/ volume; the filename does not establish a changed U.S. 4.52 build

generalNotes.subject: 3.73 single-file and multipart packaging
notes: The standalone and four-part 3.73 Installers have identical installed-client manifests, despite different executable wrappers and Installer support/script data. They are alternative delivery packages, not byte-identical copies of the same wrapper

generalNotes.subject: 3.11 disc installer variants
notes: The Hitel and Nice discs contain different original Installer wrappers (LodR.exe and Lod.exe), but all 1,204 installed payload files match exactly, including Legend.exe

generalNotes.subject: 3.51 help-file variants
notes: The two Singapore 3.51 packages contain the same game executable and differ only in DarkAges.dat, whose changed member is crehlp.txt. One package has Singapore-customized help; the other has U.S.-matching help and a DarkAges.dat byte-identical to U.S. 3.51

generalNotes.subject: 4.21 executable and packaged patch
notes: The standalone darkages.exe and the replacement executable inside dapatch.exe are byte-identical. This is an executable-only update; a required starting version, including a route from 3.51, remains unverified

generalNotes.subject: 4.20 equivalent installer distributions
notes: The full self-extracting ACE EXE, 12-part ACE distribution and 7z setup-file repack yield the same 15 InstallShield setup files and 267 installed runtime files. The 7z repack is not the byte-identical original self-extracting EXE

generalNotes.subject: 4.20 attribution and Temuair comparison
notes: The Orphelias-labeled archive matches Temuair 4.20 in the main executable, game data and maps, and its documentation names Temuair. The archive adds Legend.cfg and Legends.prf and omits music/5.mus through music/9.mus. Its independently distinct Orphelias identity remains unconfirmed

generalNotes.subject: 5.22 distribution names
notes: Yami522c_62.exe and the Installer enclosed in Yami522c_62.7z are byte-identical. The c_62 suffix identifies a distribution variant rather than a separate 5.22c game release
The separately advertised Yami522_67.exe variant remains unrecovered; it must not be assumed byte-identical to the preserved c_62 package
